title: Scoped negative result: same-slot helper470 retirement raises the complete bit bill
head: 93db17f79703329cc4102d62add0f5290edd3775
body:
**Status: scoped negative result and exact interval replay. No new κ or supplier adoption.**

## Mathematical correction

Commit [`93db17f`](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/commit/93db17f) corrects the integral identity and the following positivity bound by restoring the missing factor `(1-a)`: if `S_r` denotes the displayed sum of integrals, the identity is `Q_r = (1-a) S_r`, not `Q_r = S_r`. Since `1-a > 0` on the stated domain, the corrected lower bound remains positive. All 57 exact-rational checks pass with this correction.

This adds a complete same-slot price audit for PR #1256's finite helper470 exception. Shrinking its existing width-eight slot to width seven and returning the freed rank to that slot's idle remainder changes the paid histogram by `e1 + e5 - e7 + e_(r+1) - e_r` (with the zero-remainder case handled separately). For the frozen width-64 interface, the raw moment strictly increases for every feasible old remainder `r=0..56`; the inherited per-call surcharge also rises.

At the pinned selected exponent, the registered exact-rational replay checks all 57 remainders and rebuilds the complete selected profile for actual old classes 2, 4 and 6. The full bill increases in all three cases. Omitting the returned rank gives a false favorable control. PR #1256's distinct two-slot relaxation remains favorable at all three actual classes, so this result does not subsume or refute that mechanism.

Exact base: `bce54fb3f895cbe5cd4c0eb477c3afeed100190f`. Four live source inputs are SHA256 and Git-blob pinned in `research/bit-inplace-retirement-seed11/SOURCES.json`; the selected review used to scope predecessor claims is pinned there as provenance.

Reproduce from the repository root with Python 3.12:

```sh
python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/bit-inplace-retirement-seed11
```

Expected: `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/bit-inplace-retirement-seed11 outcome=negative-result`.

The conclusion applies only to this profile change and the frozen inherited moment formula. It does not claim supplier admission, a new bit endpoint, a new κ, or an asymptotic theorem. Physical owner/window admission, H4 cleanup, native recursive replay, precision/tape and outer assembly remain open.

Credit: Ali Romman's PR #1043 for the earlier source-boundary deletion and hosted invoice; PR #1048 for the research direction, with its general fixed-exponent root-ordering claim rejected by the pinned selected review; PR #1256 for the finite restoration exception and two-slot relaxation; PR #1302 for native replay and full-frame closure; and PR #555 plus its cited lineage for the tuned bit word. Prepared by Cinna Davis (@1337isnot1337) with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance in review, derivation, exact interval implementation and writing. New work is Apache-2.0.
